# For()

> **For**&lt;`T`&gt;(`props`: `object`): [`GuiElement`](../interfaces/GuiElement.md)

Defined in: [src/ui/index.ts:253](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/ui/index.ts#L253)

Expand a typed, compile-time array into ordered GUI children.
The callback is interpreted once for each source item. This is not a game
dynamic_list: use ScriptedGui.dynamicLists for arrays whose contents change in game.

## Type Parameters

| Type Parameter |
| ------ |
| <a id="type-parameter-t"></a> `T` |

| ------ | ------ |
| `props` | \{ `children`: (`item`: `T`, `index`: `number`) => [`GuiChild`](../type-aliases/GuiChild.md); `each`: readonly `T`[]; \} |
| `props.children` | (`item`: `T`, `index`: `number`) => [`GuiChild`](../type-aliases/GuiChild.md) |
| `props.each` | readonly `T`[] |

## Returns

[`GuiElement`](../interfaces/GuiElement.md)

## Example

```tsx
<For each={["economy", "industry"] as const}>
  {(name, index) => <Text name={name} text={name} position={{ x: 8, y: index * 24 }} />}
</For>
```
